# Attic Access & Enclosure — Project Spec (living page)

Created November 19, 2026 by Antigravity PM on Tisa's MacBook Pro. Mirrors the dedicated [`Attic Access` Wiki Page (`#attic-access`)](https://tisa-a11y.github.io/unit4-wiki-pages/#attic-access), [`Attic Opening Plan & Checklists (EN/ES)`](https://tisa-a11y.github.io/unit4-wiki-pages/wiki-docs/attic-opening-plan.html), and [`hvac/SPEC.md`](../hvac/SPEC.md). English governs; Spanish lives in the wiki language toggle and the separate Spanish Practical Guide PDF.

- **Wiki Main Page & Submenu:** [Attic Access (`#attic-access`)](https://tisa-a11y.github.io/unit4-wiki-pages/#attic-access) · [Interactive Attic Opening Plan (EN/ES)](https://tisa-a11y.github.io/unit4-wiki-pages/wiki-docs/attic-opening-plan.html)

- **Mirrored Docs & Checklists:** [`attic/CHECKLIST.md`](CHECKLIST.md) · [`attic/reference-photos/README.md`](reference-photos/README.md) · [`hvac/ATTIC-OPENING-PLAN.md`](../hvac/ATTIC-OPENING-PLAN.md) · [`hvac/SPEC.md`](../hvac/SPEC.md) · [`hvac/CHECKLIST.md`](../hvac/CHECKLIST.md) · [`STATUS-NOW.md`](../STATUS-NOW.md)
- **Todoist Parent (John Speer, `56238243`):** [`6j3Rf8FVhMVQ7vQf`](https://app.todoist.com/app/task/6j3Rf8FVhMVQ7vQf) · **Beads:** `unit4-5t5`
- **Status:** Planning & field verification active for Mon Nov 23 (2–4 p.m. PT) NEXT walkthrough with Serge & Alex (`planning only — zero ceiling cuts, lumber purchases, or furnace install released until Steps 1–2 and enclosure gates pass`).

---

## Concept
A clean, air-sealed, insulated **`24" × 36"` finished-clear** permanent attic access with a safe **`24"` continuous wood walkway (`≤ 20 ft`)**, level **`30" × 30"` service platform**, entrance-switched enclosed **LED utility light**, and **line-side 120V GFCI service outlet** ready for NEXT's Carrier/Bryant Legacy furnace.

---

## Special Notes: Attic Enclosure
**All 5 enclosure rules below govern any attic hatch or temporary ceiling closure. Do NOT buy hatch lumber or cut the ceiling until Gates 1, 4, and 5 are resolved.**

1. **Ceiling fire-rating assembly check BEFORE buying or cutting the custom wood kit:**
   - Confirm first whether the candidate ceiling (Door 4 landing vs. interior hall) forms part of a protected stair/corridor or other fire-rated separation ([R5 p. 2](https://tisa-a11y.github.io/unit4-wiki-pages/wiki-docs/attic-hatch-r5/Attic-hatch-practical-guide_R5_EN.pdf), [R5 p. 5](https://tisa-a11y.github.io/unit4-wiki-pages/wiki-docs/attic-hatch-r5/Attic-hatch-practical-guide_R5_EN.pdf)).
   - If a fire-rated hatch is required, install the accepted complete listed fire-rated ceiling assembly preserving the full **`24" × 36"` finished-clear** passage; the proposed custom wood kit and its `27-1/2" × 39-1/2"` ceiling cut do **not** apply.
   - Also inspect joists from inside the existing attic access and confirm bay width `B` (`B = 27-1/2"` fits; `B > 27-1/2"` uses designed solid side backing; `B < 27-1/2"` requires a resolved structural plan or alternate spot — never shrink `24" × 36"` clear) before any ceiling cut ([R5 p. 5](https://tisa-a11y.github.io/unit4-wiki-pages/wiki-docs/attic-hatch-r5/Attic-hatch-practical-guide_R5_EN.pdf)).

2. **Continuous air-seal & thermal barrier ([R5 p. 3](https://tisa-a11y.github.io/unit4-wiki-pages/wiki-docs/attic-hatch-r5/Attic-hatch-practical-guide_R5_EN.pdf), [R5 p. 6](https://tisa-a11y.github.io/unit4-wiki-pages/wiki-docs/attic-hatch-r5/Attic-hatch-practical-guide_R5_EN.pdf), [R5 p. 8](https://tisa-a11y.github.io/unit4-wiki-pages/wiki-docs/attic-hatch-r5/Attic-hatch-practical-guide_R5_EN.pdf)):**
   - **Fixed-frame gap:** Press **`3/8"` backer rod** into the frame-to-ceiling gap and finish with **paintable sealant** around the fixed frame.
   - **Ledge weatherstrip:** Apply continuous **`1/2" × 1/8"` closed-cell weatherstrip** on clean `1×2` lid ledges (do not stretch around corners; keep weatherstrip clean of paint and caulk).
   - **Uncaulked removable lid seam:** Leave the removable lid perimeter seam **completely uncaulked** and free of bridging paint so the hatch stays operable (test-open twice).
   - **Lid insulation & retention:** Cover the attic face of the lid with **two unfaced fiberglass batts** (`12-5/8" × 37-1/4"` cut from `15" × 48"` batts) matching the attic R-value/thickness, held in place with **3 loose 16-gauge galvanized wire loops** and **6 screw eyes (`≤ 1/2"` threaded shanks** so screws never pierce the painted ceiling face and batts remain lofted, not compressed).
   - **4-sided plywood insulation dam:** Install a **4-sided plywood insulation dam** (from walkway offcuts) around the outside of the frame standing **`2"` above any loose-fill insulation** so loose fill cannot spill into the hatch or living space.

3. **Proposed recessed `~1-1/2"` wood lid finish (pending owner OK) & clear compression latches ([R5 p. 3](https://tisa-a11y.github.io/unit4-wiki-pages/wiki-docs/attic-hatch-r5/Attic-hatch-practical-guide_R5_EN.pdf), [R5 p. 6](https://tisa-a11y.github.io/unit4-wiki-pages/wiki-docs/attic-hatch-r5/Attic-hatch-practical-guide_R5_EN.pdf)):**
   - The R5 wood-kit detail places the removable `3/4"` plywood lid recessed **`~1-1/2"`** above the ceiling face (on `1×2` ledges standing `1-1/2"` vertical + `1/8"` compressed weatherstrip), finished with flat `1×3` square-butt trim and two recessed folding ring pulls (through-bolted with bolt ends covered under the insulation). **This recessed wood-cover finish is proposed only and remains pending explicit owner approval** before cutting or fabrication.
   - Both quarter-turn panel **compression latches/fasteners** (with retained cams/keepers; select grip range only after measuring actual lid + ledge thickness) and all fixed hardware, ledges, and trim must sit **completely outside the `24" × 36"` finished-clear passage**. Demonstrate controlled lift, tilt, and safe lid parking on the flat landing away from the stair edge.

4. **Temporary bedroom closet enclosure hold ([R5 p. 5](https://tisa-a11y.github.io/unit4-wiki-pages/wiki-docs/attic-hatch-r5/Attic-hatch-practical-guide_R5_EN.pdf), [R5 p. 8](https://tisa-a11y.github.io/unit4-wiki-pages/wiki-docs/attic-hatch-r5/Attic-hatch-practical-guide_R5_EN.pdf)):**
   - **Step 1 first:** John measures and photographs the existing open temporary bedroom-closet ceiling (clear width × length, joist/framing direction & spacing, headroom, and obstructions) under [`6j3j3pXFrFWhH2w7`](https://app.todoist.com/app/task/6j3j3pXFrFWhH2w7) before any closet framing or closure.

---

## 1. Layout & Wall Geometry (Live Magicplan & `K-S4` Reconciliation)

- **Flat Wall vs. Alcove Math (`K-S4` R8 vs. `SPEC.md` §2 & Nov 7 Record):**
  - **Open-Stud Site Condition (`P03-IMG_5152.jpeg` & Magicplan `abb2d2c6`):** The actual West range wall photo shows open redwood studs, the South step corner, an existing left-side framed pipe/flue chase, existing lower stub framing, and ceiling vent — verify Friday whether that existing left chase stays, shifts, or opens during blocking prep.
  - **Sheet `K-S4` R8 (`2026-11-02`) & Live Magicplan MASTER (`44f4fc6f` / `abb2d2c6`):** West wall is a flat **`66-1/4"`** run from the south step corner (`31-1/2"` step) to the north corner, configured as **`18"` base + `30"` Viking range + `18"` base = `66"`** (`C/L = 33"`, leaving `1/4"` total / `1/8"` per side scribe tolerance; zero margin without field span check). Counter height target is `36"` AFF; **NO upper cabinets** appear on the West range wall; full-height statement tile (`~32 sq ft`) spans counter to ceiling (`121-1/2"`).
  - **`SPEC.md` §2 & Nov 7 Arched Niche Note (`millwork-specialist` check):** `SPEC.md` §2 describes *"range in a 42-in alcove with 4-in pilasters = 66 in,"* while `2026-11-07_U4_kitchen_range-alcove-arch_SOURCE-RECORD.md` records Tisa's explicit classification that the arched alcove/niches are a **nice-to-have** and not a measured construction plan. Geometrically, `42" + (2 × 4") = 50"` on a `66-1/4"` wall leaves **`16-1/4"` (`8-1/8"` per side)** — breaking full-height `18"` base cabinets unless any `4"` pilasters are strictly counter-mounted above `36"` AFF (`6"` clear space + `4"` pilaster + `8"` cabinet edge) AND satisfy Viking's `≥ 6"` horizontal side clearance to combustibles (`S10` p. 10).
  - **Friday Baseline Rule:** Lay out Friday blocking and mock-hang centered at **`C/L = 33"`** on the flat `66-1/4"` wall (`K-S4`), extending blocking wide enough (`12"–54"` on the `66-1/4"` span) to support either flat wall or future `42"` pilasters if later locked.

---

## 2. Framing, Blocking, Tile Backer & Clearance Assembly

### 2.1 Framing & Wood Blocking Specification (`framing-carpenter` + `Zephyr Manual` p. 4)
- **Material & Flatness:** Install **flush continuous `2×` solid lumber** or **inset `3/4"` structural plywood** between studs (exceeds Zephyr Manual p. 4 minimum `3/8"` wood backing), shimmed plumb and flat to **`≤ 1/8"` in `10 ft`** (`≤ 1/16"` in `2 ft` if tile format `≥ 15"`, `tile-setter`), extending **1 full stud bay past** each side of the hood/cover footprint (`kitchen-rough-in-before-closein` §6).
- **Two Horizontal Hood Backing Bands + Anti-Tip Zone:**
  1. **Lower Hanger Backing Band:** **`66"` to `86"` AFF** (`66" + t` to `86" + t` subfloor) across the `29-7/8"` hood + 1 stud bay L/R. Covers both Line A lower safety/lock fasteners (`fig. A`, Manual p. 5) down to the `66"` AFF Viking minimum AND the full `Line B` hanger zone (`75-9/16"` to `81-9/16"` AFF across `9-27/32"` horizontal screw spread centered on `C/L 33"`).
  2. **Upper Duct-Cover Bracket Backing Band (Continuous Across `C/L 33"`):** **`104"` to `121-1/2"` AFF** (`104" + t` to `121-1/2" + t` subfloor) running **continuously across `C/L = 33"`** behind the entire `8-5/8"` chimney footprint + 1 stud bay L/R. Because the `6"` vertical rigid duct rises **in front of the finished wall** inside the `7-1/2"`-deep chimney cover (`Manual` p. 4 `Mounting the Duct Cover`), do NOT leave a vertical gap in the wall backing across `C/L 33"` that would leave top-bracket screws unbacked.
  3. **Range Anti-Tip Wall/Floor Prep (`S10` p. 18):** Measure `Measurement (A)` on the owned Viking rear anti-tip slot after legs are leveled; place solid bottom-plate/stud blocking at **`Measurement (A) + 1/4"` AFF** (`+ t` subfloor), **`22-1/4"` left of the right side edge** of the range bay (`25-3/4"` from S step corner), so anti-tip screws bite structural framing/floor.
- **Ceiling Duct Bay (Above Top Plate / Soffit Bottom):** Frame/preserve a centered **`8"–10"` clear ceiling-joist & top-plate bay** at `C/L = 33"` for the `6"` rigid vertical duct (`7-1/2"` chimney depth lets the duct clear flush wall backing below the top plate); check existing ceiling duct `X/Y` offset from West wall face Friday and do **not** notch load-bearing joists or double top plates without structural sign-off.
- **Fastener Embedment:** Pre-drill statement tile before fastening; size corrosion-resistant wood screws through `tile + thinset + cement backer` (`TO MEASURE IN FIELD`) to achieve **`≥ 1-1/2"` embedment into solid wood blocking** (never drywall anchors).

### 2.2 Viking `VGCC5304BSS` Combustible & Non-Combustible Clearances (`S10` pp. 4, 8, 10–11, 20; `code-specialist`)
- **Below `36"` AFF (Sides):** `0"` clearance to adjacent `36"` high base cabinets. **Cabinet finish rating (`S10` p. 4):** materials/adhesives must withstand **`194°F (90°C)`** without discoloring or delaminating. **Side-trim height (`S10` pp. 10, 17, 20):** top of Viking side trim MUST sit **`3/8"` above adjacent countertop**; level on uneven floors with **metal shims only** (p. 17).
- **Above `36"` AFF (Sides):** Minimum **`6"`** horizontal side clearance from range body to any side walls, pilasters, or vertical projections. Wall cabinets within that `6"` side zone may be no deeper than `13"` and must be **`≥ 18"` above countertop (`≥ 54"` AFF)**.
- **Rear Wall Fire Clearance (`CRITICAL CODE CATCH`):**
  - Viking ships standard with a **`1"` Island Trim**, which requires **`6"` rear clearance to a combustible wall** (`S10` pp. 8, 11).
  - **Code note (`S10` p. 11; `CMC 919.4` / `303.10.1` / `CBC 703.3`):** HardieBacker (`ASTM E136`) and porcelain/ceramic tile mounted over wood studs or gypsum board are **NOT** automatically a CSA/ANSI-certified `0"` non-combustible wall assembly — `S10` p. 11 explicitly requires **authority having jurisdiction (DBI AHJ) approval** for `0"` rear clearance behind Island Trim.
  - Installing Viking's **`8"` Backguard** with factory rear standoff brackets achieves **`0"` rear clearance** to a combustible wall (`S10` pp. 8, 11, 20), adding `3/4"` depth (`24-5/16"` + `3/4"` = `25-1/16"` side panel) unless standoff brackets are removed against an AHJ-verified non-combustible wall. **Verify owned range backguard/trim downstairs before framing/tile release.**

### 2.3 Cement Backer Board, `5/8"` Type X Drywall Transition & Firestopping (`drywall-plaster`)
- **Substrate Thickness Delta:** Nominal `1/2"` **HardieBacker 500 measures `0.42"` thick** vs. `5/8"` Type X drywall **`0.625"`** — **`0.205"` shy** (`0.125"` shy if using `0.50"` cement board).
  - **Non-rated interior partition path:** Shim West-wall studs above `36"` AFF (`66-1/4"` wide) with **`3/16"`** furring strips (`1/8"` if `0.50"` board) so the backer + tile bed finishes flush against adjacent `5/8"` Type X drywall at flanking corners/ceiling without lippage.
  - **If West wall is a 1-hr rated dwelling-unit/corridor/shaft assembly (verify before close-in):** Run continuous **`5/8"` Type X gypsum board** floor-to-ceiling behind the backer board to preserve the hourly fire-resistance rating.
- **Seams & Air/Fire Sealing:** Tape all backer seams with `2"` alkali-resistant fiberglass mesh embedded in thinset (`Level 2` pre-tile finish). Pack the `6"` hood duct ceiling/top-plate penetration with **mineral wool + fireblock sealant (`CBC §718`**, or UL-listed through-penetration firestop if rated), use fireblock/putty pads at wiring penetrations, and **air-seal ALL wall and floor openings behind and underneath the Viking range** (`S10` pp. 12, 14).
